explanation: Generated one EXCLURAD eta-channel input containing the requested 3x3 grid (9 points) at cos(theta*) = 0 and phi* = 90 degrees. Preflight passed all points with no kinematic or lookup-table warnings. Full O(alpha) radiative corrections and the validated eta defaults vcut = 0.166 GeV^2 and beam energy = 6.53 GeV were used. Because the beam energy was not specified and radiative corrections depend on it, the assumed 6.53 GeV CLAS12 RG-K campaign energy is explicitly flagged.
